entries.title: Psalms 113:1
segments: ¶Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

entries.title: Psalms 113:2
segments: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 113:3
segments: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name [is] to be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 113:4
segments: The LORD [is] high above all nations, [and] his glory above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 113:5
segments: Who [is] like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high, {dwelleth...: Heb. exalteth himself to dwell}

entries.title: Psalms 113:6
segments: Who humbleth [himself] to behold [the things that are] in heaven, and in the earth!

entries.title: Psalms 113:7
segments: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, [and] lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

entries.title: Psalms 113:8
segments: That he may set [him] with princes, [even] with the princes of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 113:9
segments: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [and to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD. {to keep...: Heb. to dwell in an house}
